gloss: to throw off (clothes); to cast off

definitions.gloss: to throw off (clothes); to leave lying where taken off
definitions.explanation: To take off clothes or shoes and leave them where they fall, without putting them away.

definitions.gloss: to cast off (an old self, habits, ideas)
definitions.explanation: Figuratively, to break free of an old way of thinking, a role or one's former self.

examples.english: Shoes have been kicked off and left in the entryway.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: transitive. Pattern: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{脱|ぬ}ぎ{捨|す}てる.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{脱|ぬ}ぎ{捨|す}てる: to throw off one's clothes
- {脱|ぬ}ぎ{捨|す}てた⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧: clothes left lying around
- ⟦{殻|から}→殻：02148_kara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{脱|ぬ}ぎ{捨|す}てる: to break out of one's shell
- ⟦{仮面|かめん}→仮面：11439_kamen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{脱|ぬ}ぎ{捨|す}てる: to drop the mask, show one's true self

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{脱|ぬ}ぐ→脱ぐ：00518_nugu⟧: to take off (neutral); {脱|ぬ}ぎ{捨|す}てる adds carelessness or a decisive break
- ⟦{捨|す}てる→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧: to throw away
